format.bundle_json: JCS {schema, created, records: [{name, version, archive_sha256, record_member_sha256, record, archive}]} where record_member_sha256 hashes the exact record member bytes and record/archive are member paths
format.certificate_member: bundle.cert.json is JCS {statement, signature} for ck-key-cert/v1, signed by the TEST-ONLY root
format.signature_member: bundle.sig is 128 lowercase hexadecimal ASCII bytes
format.archive: one strict ustar archive; component archives remain their own raw strict ustar bytes

keys.WARNING: TEST-ONLY keys derived from published fixed seed text; never trust them outside these vectors.

root.WARNING: TEST-ONLY KEY. The seed is published. Never trust anything signed by it outside these vectors.
root.label: TEST-ONLY @cortexkit root key
root.seed_derivation: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of seed_text
root.seed_text: ck-catalog-v1 TEST-ONLY @cortexkit ROOT key. Published on purpose. Never trust anything it signs.

publish.WARNING: TEST-ONLY KEY. The seed is published. Never trust anything signed by it outside these vectors.
publish.label: TEST-ONLY @cortexkit publish key 1
publish.seed_derivation: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of seed_text
publish.seed_text: ck-catalog-v1 TEST-ONLY @cortexkit publish key 1. Published on purpose. Never trust anything it signs.

registry_status.WARNING: TEST-ONLY KEY. The seed is published. Never trust anything signed by it outside these vectors.
registry_status.label: TEST-ONLY registry status key 1
registry_status.seed_derivation: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes of seed_text
registry_status.seed_text: ck-catalog-v1 TEST-ONLY registry status key 1. Published on purpose. Never trust anything it signs.

cases.name: bad_bundle_signature
cases.note: the first signature byte is flipped; bundle.json and the root-certified signer are unchanged

cases.name: bundle_key_not_root_certified
cases.note: the bundle signer is publisher key 2, but its certificate was signed by publish key 1 instead of the root

cases.name: archive_sha256_mismatch
cases.note: one byte of the first component archive changes while bundle.json retains its original digest

cases.name: record_member_bytes_changed
cases.note: the first record member's status sequence changes while bundle.json and bundle.sig remain unchanged

cases.name: record_missing_status
cases.note: the first signed record file omits its latest status envelope

cases.name: non_ustar_entry
cases.note: bundle.json has a non-POSIX ustar magic while its header checksum remains valid

cases.name: path_escaping_entry
cases.note: a regular-file member uses a parent-directory path

cases.name: extra_unlisted_file
cases.note: a regular file is added without a reference from bundle.json
